import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('funder_report_Q1.xlsx').dropna(subset=['% Achievement'])
behind = df[df['Achieved'] < df['Target']].copy()
behind['% Achievement'] = (behind['Achieved'] / behind['Target'] * 100).round(1)
cols = ['Indicator', 'Target', 'Achieved', '% Achievement', 'Remarks']
print(behind[cols].to_string(index=False))
